title: For & Since
objectives: Use for & since accurately in A2 contexts.
Understand form, meaning, and typical usage.
Produce short spoken and written examples.
canDo: I can use for and since with present perfect duration.

warmUp.title: Activate prior knowledge
warmUp.prompt: Before this lesson, recall what you know about for & since. How is it similar or different from Portuguese?
reflectionQuestions: When do native speakers use for & since?
Can you think of one example?

explanation:
Since + point (since 2020, since Monday) | For + period (for three years)

Present perfect with unfinished time

grammar.title: For & Since
grammar.rule: Since + point (since 2020, since Monday) | For + period (for three years)

examples.sentence: How long have you known her?

vocabulary.example: How long have you known her?

sentences: How long have you known her?

reading.title: For & Since in Context
reading.text: I have known him since university. She has worked here for six months. How long have you had this car? — For about five years.

writing.prompt: Write a short paragraph (5–7 sentences) using for & since. Use at least 3 words from the vocabulary list.
rubricHints: Use the target structure at least twice.
writing.modelAnswer: Since last year. For two hours. How long have you known her? The duration of the contract.

tutorHints: Correct gently and ask the learner to reformulate.
Use English for meta-language when possible at A2.
